Abstract.AbstractText: A polydimethylsiloxane cylindrical-hole-template-confined solution-growth method is developed to fabricate densely packed CsPbCl3-x Br x microdisk laser arrays. Furthermore, a strategy to integrate multicolored microdisk laser (MDL) arrays is demonstrated that simultaneously lase in the deep blue, blue, cyan, and green by means of gas-phase replacement of Cl by Br from initial CsPbCl3 MDLs in HBr vapor.
